title: Effective degradation of DELTA pesticide in soil by an atmospheric-pressure cold plasma-DBD system
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2585-2596
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08882H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sushma Jangra, Abhijit Mishra, Ritesh Mishra, Shikha Pandey, Ram Prakash
Degradation of deltamethrin in soil was achieved using an ACP-DBD system, where plasma-generated RONS interact with pesticide molecules, leading to molecular breakdown into less toxic intermediates and improved soil quality.
